title: test: claude-plugin postToolUse tests read the launcher's MOE_PROJECT_PATH and send a fake tool event to the live daemon
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate's regression run (task-808869c5). This is not Wave 1 code.

In any session launched by scripts/moe-agent.* (MOE_PROJECT_PATH set), `cd packages/moe-claude-plugin && npm test` fails 2 of 13:
- 'forwards moe.* tool events with the expected envelope': expected 1 frame, got 0.
- 'does not throw when the daemon is unreachable': forwarded is true.

Cause: runPostToolUseHook prefers MOE_PROJECT_PATH over input.cwd (src/postToolUse.ts:84-88), so the hook reaches the LIVE daemon. The first case posts AGENT_TOOL_EVENT {workerId:'worker-test', tool:'moe.start_step'} into the real project's event stream.

With MOE_PROJECT_PATH and MOE_WORKER_ID unset the suite is 13/13. That is why it stays green in CI and red in agent sessions.
definitionOfDone: The postToolUse tests save, clear and restore MOE_PROJECT_PATH exactly as they already do MOE_WORKER_ID, so no case can reach a daemon outside its own fixture
npm test in packages/moe-claude-plugin passes with MOE_PROJECT_PATH set to an unrelated live project and with it unset

implementationPlan.note:
One-file test change; src/postToolUse.ts untouched. runPostToolUseHook describe: beforeEach saves+deletes MOE_PROJECT_PATH (captured per test, not at module load); afterEach restores it FIRST, before the wss/server closes, so a failing close cannot strand the launcher binding. Pin: forwards-envelope test starts with expect(process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH).toBeUndefined(). Per-test MOE_WORKER_ID save/restore left as is.

RED proven without touching the live daemon: scratch harness (outside repo, %TEMP%/moe-0e967fa1-decoy.mjs) runs the suite with MOE_PROJECT_PATH pointed at a decoy project whose .moe/daemon.json targets a counting WS server. HEAD: 2 failed | 11 passed, decoy got 2 leaked AGENT_TOOL_EVENT frames (worker-test moe.start_step + moe.list_tasks). Pin alone: fails with "expected 'C:\Users\...\Temp\moe…' to be undefined". After fix: 13/13, decoy frames=0.
Plan commands (PowerShell, from packages/moe-claude-plugin): $env:MOE_PROJECT_PATH='D:\projexts\moes'; npm test -> 13 passed, exit 0; var removed -> 13 passed, exit 0; MOE_WORKER_ID also removed -> 13 passed, exit 0. Standalone tsc --noEmit --strict on the test file: exit 0.
Shared checkout: ~30 other dirty paths (roles/skills docs, daemon recommendSkill/startStep, scripts, .moe/tasks) belong to other sessions; not touched.

implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial review, no code change this step.
- src untouched: git diff --stat -- packages/moe-claude-plugin/src is empty; only tests/postToolUse.test.ts modified in the package. Production MOE_PROJECT_PATH preference (PowerShell launcher binding) intact; both launchers export it (moe-agent.sh:625, moe-agent.ps1:318), so the new comments are accurate.
- Restore: prev value captured per test in beforeEach before any await; afterEach restores it first (before wss/server close), and vitest runs afterEach even after a failing test or beforeEach. Empty-string originals round-trip ('' !== undefined).
- No live event: decoy run with MOE_PROJECT_PATH set -> frames=0. Live .moe/activity.log (last entry 21:07:41Z, so it is being written) has only the 4 old worker-test AGENT_TOOL_EVENTs (latest 2026-09-18T17:25:08Z, gate run), none from my with-env runs at ~21:07Z/21:08Z.
- daemonClient tests always pass an explicit projectPath (wins over MOE_PROJECT_PATH), so no other leak in the package.
- Theoretical only: shared prevProjectPath would race if someone enabled test.concurrent in this describe; same limit as the existing MOE_WORKER_ID pattern. Pin only bites where the var is set (agent sessions / with-env verification), by plan decision.
Fresh verification (PowerShell, packages/moe-claude-plugin): $env:MOE_PROJECT_PATH='D:\projexts\moes'; npm test -> Tests 13 passed (13), exit 0; var removed -> 13 passed, exit 0. Scratch harness deleted from %TEMP%.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Two options: (1) change runPostToolUseHook to prefer input.cwd over MOE_PROJECT_PATH so tests pass without env isolation — rejected: the production preference is load-bearing for the PowerShell claude launcher (comment at postToolUse.ts:84-88) and is not this bug; (2) isolate MOE_PROJECT_PATH in the tests the same way MOE_WORKER_ID is already saved/cleared/restored. (2) is the decision and the DoD. Do not edit src/postToolUse.ts.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: tests/postToolUse.test.ts already save/clear/restore MOE_WORKER_ID inside the two hook cases that set it, and MOE_DISABLE_TOOL_HOOK in a third. MOE_PROJECT_PATH is never touched, so a moe-agent session leaks D:\projexts\moes into runPostToolUseHook, which then reads the live .moe/daemon.json instead of the fixture. Classifier tests do not call the hook. Isolate at the runPostToolUseHook describe (beforeEach delete, afterEach restore) so every hook case uses input.cwd. Capture the original value once in beforeAll/beforeEach, not at module load. afterEach is the error handling path: it must restore even when a test throws.
planningNotes.risks: Restoring a captured-at-module-load value can restore a stale copy if another file mutates the env; capture in beforeEach. Do not delete MOE_PROJECT_PATH without restoring — this session's wrapper needs it after the suite. Do not change production env preference. vitest may run files in parallel; this file only needs to isolate its own process env for its duration.

completionSummary:
Test-only fix in packages/moe-claude-plugin/tests/postToolUse.test.ts; src/postToolUse.ts untouched (the production MOE_PROJECT_PATH preference is load-bearing for the PowerShell launcher). The runPostToolUseHook describe's beforeEach now saves and deletes MOE_PROJECT_PATH, capturing it per test rather than at module load. afterEach restores it first, before closing wss/server, so a failing close cannot strand the launcher binding. As a pin, the forwards-envelope test now starts with expect(process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH).toBeUndefined(). The per-test MOE_WORKER_ID save/restore is unchanged.
Red/green without touching the live daemon: a scratch decoy harness (a WS server behind a temp .moe/daemon.json, not committed, since deleted) ran the suite with MOE_PROJECT_PATH pointed at it. At HEAD: 2 failed, 11 passed, and the decoy received 2 leaked worker-test AGENT_TOOL_EVENT frames. With only the pin added, the pin failed with "expected 'C:\...\Temp\moe…' to be undefined". After the fix: 13/13 passed and 0 frames leaked.
Live .moe/activity.log has no new worker-test events from the with-env runs; the only 4 are from the 2026-09-18 17:25Z gate run. Standalone strict tsc on the test file: exit 0.
